additions.site_name: Land West of Ipswich Road, Keswick, Norfolk (South Norfolk)
additions.name: Keswick data centre, Ipswich Road - proposed data centre with substations and backup generators (South Norfolk 2026/2957)

status.summary: South Norfolk Council's statutory planning notice dated 15 October 2026 (Eastern Daily Press) publicises full application 2026/2957, validated in the week ending 9 October 2026, for the construction of a data centre (Use Class B8) with ancillary offices, associated infrastructure, substations, backup generators, access, parking, landscaping and sustainable drainage on land west of Ipswich Road, Keswick, as a major development. This dated government record identifies the proposed data-centre development, so it is announced as of 15 October 2026. The application is undecided; no consent, site work or construction is asserted, and no applicant, operator or capacity is named in the council's records.

locator.precision: Grid reference (British National Grid E 621669, N 304466) that South Norfolk Council publishes for application 2026/2957 in its weekly list of validated applications, converted to WGS84 with pyproj 3.7.1. It is the council's map point for the application site, not a red-line boundary, building footprint or surveyed position.
locator.identity_review: The weekly list ties the grid reference to application 2026/2957, 'Land West Of Ipswich Road Keswick Norfolk', for the construction of a data centre; the council's 15 October 2026 statutory notice lists the same reference, location and proposal. The list gives a separate grid reference for every application, so the value is specific to this application rather than a parish default. In Esri World Imagery viewed locally (not redistributed) the point falls inside an open arable field about 230 m west of Ipswich Road (A140) and about 530 m north-west of its junction with the A47, i.e. on undeveloped land west of Ipswich Road in Keswick and Intwood parish. No geocoder, postcode centroid, town centre or estate centroid is used. The red-line plan could not be read because the council's online planning register host did not respond.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The council does not state how the grid reference was placed or which part of the site it marks, and the application boundary was not obtained; the proposed data centre, substations and parking are likely to extend a few hundred metres around the point within the fields west of Ipswich Road.

additions.name: Vantage LHR21 (London II) - six-storey data centre under construction and commissioning (EA permit EPR/VP3225SC)

status.summary: The Environment Agency's compliance assessment report VP3225SC/0605191, issued 17 August 2026, records a site inspection and liaison meeting on 11 August 2026 at Vantage LHR21, 37-39 North Acton Road (permit EPR/VP3225SC, holder VDC LHR21 Limited), held 'for the commissioning of the site which was still under construction'. The officer saw an external engine ready for craning, engine containers with empty bays and some fuel pipework still under construction and blanked off; of the belly tanks for generators 5 to 8 only generator 5's was in use. This dated first-hand regulator observation supports under-construction status as of 11 August 2026 for the LHR21 data centre and its permitted standby plant. Commissioning was under way, and final commissioning is expected in Q1 2027 (a forecast, not a stage). Vantage's September 2025 statement that LHR2 would open at the end of that month was a target, not an observation; its current London II page still describes the campus as under development. No completion or operation is asserted.

locator.precision: Site location published by the Environment Agency's installations register for permit EPR/VP3225SC (holder VDC LHR21 Limited, 'Vantage LHR21', 37-39 North Acton Road, NW10 6PF): grid reference TQ2080483004, latitude 51.533022, longitude -0.259746, copied without transformation. It is 10 m from the ONS centroid of postcode NW10 6PF, so it locates the permitted site through its address; it is not a building outline or surveyed position.
locator.identity_review: The permit register entry, the 11 August 2026 inspection report and the London Planning Datahub all refer to the same property, 37-39 North Acton Road, NW10 6PF: the register names the site 'Vantage LHR21', the report names the operator VDC LHR21 Limited and records Vantage's permitting, operations and project managers on site, and OPDC outline permission 20/0122/OUTOPDC with reserved matters 22/0142/REMOPDC (commenced 4 April 2023) permit a data centre of up to 25,000 sq m GEA at that address. Vantage's London II page describes LHR2 as a one-acre campus with one six-storey data centre in the PowerGate district. In Esri World Imagery viewed locally (not redistributed) the point falls on the roof of a dark multi-storey building with extensive roof plant on the east side of North Acton Road. A pyproj 3.7.1 transform of the register's easting and northing lands 0.7 m from the published point. No geocoder, town centre or estate centroid is used; the Datahub's 0.08 ha polygon for the outline is too small to represent the site and is not used.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The register publishes no positional accuracy and its point lies 10 m from the postcode centroid; the six-storey data centre occupies about half a hectare around it.

additions.name: Vantage LHR11/12 (London I) - two-building data centre campus under construction (EA permit EPR/YP3329SB)

status.summary: The Environment Agency's compliance assessment report YP3329SB/0605385, issued 17 August 2026, records a 'Site inspection - still under construction' on 11 August 2026 at LHR11/12, Chandos Road (permit EPR/YP3329SB, holder VDC LHR11 Limited), carried out under construction-site (CDM) control with Vantage's permitting and operations managers. The officer notes that one building ('LHR 10' in the report) is near complete and that the second separate building is yet to be started, and inspected the fuel system, stacks, SCR system and the engines installed at ground level. This dated first-hand regulator observation supports under-construction status as of 11 August 2026 for the two-building data-centre campus; it does not establish completion or operation of either building, and the second building's works had not begun.

locator.precision: Site location published by the Environment Agency's installations register for permit EPR/YP3329SB (holder VDC LHR11 Limited, 'LHR11/12', 2 Black Arrow House, Chandos Road, NW10 6NF): grid reference TQ2115082355, latitude 51.527115, longitude -0.254983, copied without transformation. It is a site point for the permitted installation, not a building outline or surveyed position.
locator.identity_review: The permit register entry and the 11 August 2026 inspection report refer to the same site, LHR11/12 at Chandos Road, NW10 6NF, operated by VDC LHR11 Limited with Vantage's LHR11 operations manager on site. The register point lies inside the 2.02 ha site polygon that the London Planning Datahub holds for OPDC record 23/0176/NMAOPDC, a non-material amendment to outline permission 21/0013/OUTOPDC for a data centre of up to 52,000 sq m GEA at the Chandos Road Trading Estate (47.8 m inside the boundary, 29.2 m from its centroid; shapely 2.1.1), and 64 m from the NW10 6NF postcode centroid, so it is not a postcode copy. Vantage's London I page describes LHR1 as a 2 ha campus with two multi-storey data centres in the PowerGate district. In Esri World Imagery viewed locally (not redistributed) the point falls in a cleared construction area immediately south of a tall dark building with roof plant, matching one building near completion and a second not yet started. A pyproj 3.7.1 transform of the register's easting and northing lands 0.7 m from the published point. No geocoder, town centre or estate centroid is used.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The register publishes no positional accuracy and does not say which part of the site it marks; the two-building campus covers about 2 ha around the point.
